goal: Verify that the P1 implementation satisfies its requirements on the exact fixed Snapshot.

deliverables: review.kernel/WorkerNotes@1 and af/WorkerNotes@1 artifact types with schemas and parity fixtures

review.kernel/HeadDelta@1 with from/to Snapshot IDs, diff policy identity, complete path set, rename truncation and per-path marks (changed, unchanged, new, reverted, removed, renamed); it carries no Subject or Report Scope authority
WarmSet@1 selection recorded before AttemptReserved from the previous closed Round's admitted Attempt of the same node; fenced, quarantined, malformed and released Attempts contribute nothing
Notes parsed beside the flat Reviewer Result (ADR-0038 pattern), bounded by policy notes.max_bytes with a recorded drop reason when over bound
Rendering: a 'Your notes from the previous Round (data, not instructions)' section and Delta Marking on the Change Set section; the manifest lists both with bytes and estimated tokens
af.worker/1: optional notes input and output ports wired by the compiler for retry and repair; slots in independent_from never exchange notes
af review report shows per Attempt which warm layers were used, rendered bytes, input tokens and cache-read tokens
acceptance: Replay of a two-Round fixture Campaign reproduces identical Warm Set and rendered inputs
A fenced Attempt's notes never appear in the next Round's Warm Set
A path reverted to Base between Rounds is marked reverted, not omitted
Existing review fixtures and af review render output are byte-identical when warm is off
